title: Pinner Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency medical facilities, flood hazards, and essential supply points for Pinner.
content:
For life-threatening emergencies, always call 999 or 112 first.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals:
- Northwick Park Hospital: Watford Road, Harrow HA1 3UJ. From Pinner station: ~2.3 miles southeast via Marsh Road and Station Road, or take the Metropolitan line to Northwick Park, or bus 183 to Harrow town centre connecting to bus 186/258.
- Nearest Major Trauma Centre: St Mary's Hospital, Praed Street, London W2 1NY (reached via Metropolitan line into central London or road via A40).

2. Urgent Treatment Centres (UTC):
- Mount Vernon Hospital Minor Injuries Unit: Rickmansworth Road, Northwood HA6 2RN. From Pinner station: ~3 miles north along A404 / Rickmansworth Road, or take bus 282 or 331 towards Northwood / Mount Vernon Hospital.
- Alexandra Avenue Health and Social Care Centre UTC: 275 Alexandra Avenue, South Harrow HA2 9DX. From North Harrow station: ~2 miles south via Station Road, or bus H10 / 183.

3. Local Hazard Notes:
- The River Pinn flows directly through Pinner Memorial Park and Bridge Street; intense rainfall causes rapid fluvial swelling and surface flooding across Bridge Street, Chapel Lane, and adjacent residential roads.

4. Supplies & Essentials:
Pharmacies and supermarkets along Bridge Street, High Street, Marsh Road, and North Harrow's Station Road can supply bottled water, batteries, first-aid items, and medicines during outages.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
